Hulk Looks Significantly Bigger in Spider-Man: Brand New Day. A side-by-side comparison between Avengers: Age of Ultron and Spider-Man: Brand New Day reveals a noticeable difference in Hulk's size. In Age of Ultron, Black Widow (around 5'7") stood next to Hulk and reached approximately up to his waist. However, in the new footage from Brand New Day, Spider-Man (Tom Holland, ~5'8") stands in front of Hulk and reaches his knee level. This visual analysis suggests that Hulk has been scaled up considerably for this film.
